keyPhrases.text: undoubtedly a triumph of exuberant stagecraft
All the ones I saw were superb
enough to make this evening a silver ticket
whether it's a golden one I'm not quite so sure
feels a couple of strawberry creams short of the full box

reasoning: Review praises technical elements and performances extensively but has significant reservations about emotional impact and musical quality. The 'silver ticket but not golden' metaphor clearly indicates mixed-positive territory - good but not great.
